newsitem.title: FRANCE: PERNOD BUYS CONTROL OF EPOM OF GREECE.
newsitem.headline: PERNOD BUYS CONTROL OF EPOM OF GREECE.

text.p: French drinks group Pernod Ricard said on Tuesday its SEGM unit had signed an agreement to take control of Greek ouzo producer EPOM.
EPOM is Greece's second biggest producer of ouzo with its Mini brand, Pernod said in a statement.
A new Greek entity will eventually be created through the merger of EPOM and Lizas & Lizas, a Greek company acquired by EPOM in 1990.
The new company will be under the control of SEGM, which manages part of the group's retailing in Europe and Africa. The deal is subject to regulatory approval.
No financial details were given. -- Paris newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
